question: Where will PM Modi attend the AI Action Summit, hosted by French President Emmanuel Macron, focusing on global AI innovation, governance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paris, France**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** will attend the **Artificial Intelligence (AI) Action Summit** in Paris, France, on **February 10-11, 2025**, as announced by **French President Emmanuel Macron**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The summit will foster **international dialogue on AI** and include participation from nations such as the **US, China, India**, and Gulf countries, which play vital roles in AI development and regulation.
 
• The event will focus on **innovation, talent attraction**, and positioning **France and Europe** as leaders in the global AI landscape.
 
• Five key themes will guide the summit: **public interest in AI, the future of work, innovation and culture, trust in AI**, and **global AI governance**.
 
• **90 countries, including India**, are invited to discuss critical topics like **misinformation and misuse of AI**, reflecting India's significant global role in AI's societal impact.
 
• The summit will be hosted at the **Grand Palais in Paris**, featuring diverse participants, including **heads of state, CEOs, academics, NGOs, and artists**.
 
• President Macron will host a formal dinner for dignitaries on **February 10**, while a dedicated **leaders' session for heads of state** is scheduled for **February 11**.
